The key is in Todoist: Settings → Integrations → Developer → API token. Copy it and paste it here.
The key is in TickTick on the web (ticktick.com): avatar → Settings → Account → API Token. Create it, copy it and paste it here.
Google doesn\'t know DP Clock yet

Google lets an app into Google Tasks only through a project in Google Cloud. Once, at console.cloud.google.com:
1. Create a project.
2. APIs and services → Library → Google Tasks API → Enable.
3. OAuth consent screen → External; add your account as a test user, or publish the app — in testing mode Google asks to sign in again every 7 days.
4. Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → Android: package com.dpsmpx.dpclock, SHA-1 21:4D:70:12:D4:3B:6C:70:DF:74:78:AC:97:35:A0:D8:48:E3:F5:51.
Then connect Google Tasks again.
